title: Stationary comparisons at specified outer filtration bounds
statement: Let D(X,K) be any family of termwise etale hypercohomology presentations [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] and let e identify each page with its actual filtered-complex cycle/boundary quotient [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality]. There are simultaneous isomorphisms eInf from page r at (q,n-q) to gr^q D.H_n whenever r>=1 and D.L^(q+r) in degree n+1 is bottom and D.L^(q-r+1) in degree n-1 is top [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For every sections-total chain map b preserving the filtration steps and every sequence map N induced by b on graded cycle representatives, the conjugated homology map c_X^{-1} H^n(b) c_Y restricts to step maps t satisfying ht. For every proof hc of successive inclusion compatibility, on pages satisfying both outer-step equalities in source and target, N under eInf equals cokernel.map(t_(q+1),t_q,hc). No support bound, inverse-image map, augmentation or first-page formula is assumed or constructed.

proof.text: Use H_formula to identify the transported image of the step homology map with H.step. Factor through this constructed image and its equality isomorphism. The resulting h is epic and satisfies the inclusion equation. All these operations use Mathlib image factorization and the existing presentation formula.

Construct epic homology image maps at every filtration index by H_formula. Apply filteredStationary_cycle_comparison to the sections total, its filtration, c and H at complementary degree n-q, rewrite q+(n-q)=n, and identify its supplied image map at q with h by cancellation of the monic H.step inclusion. The resulting normalized a and z are uniquely specified. Transport a to arbitrary q+p=n by equality induction and compose with e to construct eInf.

For b choose its step restrictions s. Homology functoriality and s followed by the target step inclusion equal to the source inclusion followed by b prove the image square. Cancel the target H.step monomorphism to show that the kernel of the source image epimorphism is killed by H(s) followed by the target image epimorphism. Abelian.epiDesc constructs t; cancel the source image epimorphism to prove ht.

For arbitrary hc, q,r and the outer bounds, introduce p and the equality q+p=n, then substitute n. Apply the page representative hypothesis to the source step cycles, their iCycles map, the target cyclesMap(s), and the normalized z maps. The inclusion squares follow from cyclesMap_i and hs. Precompose the desired equation with e.inv, the page cokernel projection, and z; all are epic. The representative hypothesis reduces the page-map expression to the target normalization equation. The two normalization equations, homologyπ naturality, comp_epiDesc and cokernel.π_desc now give equal composites. This works for every hc, using its square directly in cokernel.map.

proof_origin.place: Image factorization, specialization of the existing normalized stationary cycle comparison, dependent degree transport, epi descent and naturality; second reading removed the duplicate split-off theorem.
